edges.reason: Constructor derives owner from _msgSender and assigns it as the initial feeWallet.
ERC20 transfer/approve paths pass _msgSender() into _transfer as the from address.
onlyOwner modifier compares _msgSender() with _owner before enableTrading writes state.
withdrawFees has no owner check, so any _msgSender() can trigger the ETH drain to feeWallet.
excludeFromFees is gated by onlyOwner comparing _msgSender() with the stored owner.
enableTrading stores block.timestamp into _launchTime, creating timestamp dependence.
_transfer compares block.timestamp to _launchTime to flag launch-block snipers.
_swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
_addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
tx.origin is used to index _holderLastTransferTimestamp for the per-block purchase limit.
_transfer enforces the one-purchase-per-block rule using tx.origin as the holder key.
_transfer writes _holderLastTransferTimestamp[tx.origin] with the current block number.
_holderLastTransferTimestamp is read to validate the launch transfer delay.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
removeLimits sets limitsInEffect to false.
disableTransferDelay sets transferDelayEnabled to false.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes the new swapTokensAtAmount threshold.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount for the given address.
updateBuyFees recomputes buyTotalFees as the sum of buy fee components.
updateSellFees recomputes sellTotalFees as the sum of sell fee components.
excludeFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFees for the given account.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair helper.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes automatedMarketMakerPairs.
updateFeeWallet replaces the feeWallet state variable.
setSnipers loops over the input array writing _isSniper entries to true.
delSnipers loops over the input array writing _isSniper entries to false.
maxTransactionAmount bounds the transferred amount on buys and sells.
maxWallet bounds the recipient balance after a transfer.
swapTokensAtAmount decides whether swapBack is triggered during a transfer.
limitsInEffect gates the anti-whale and anti-bot checks.
tradingActive gates transfers before trading is enabled.
transferDelayEnabled gates the per-block purchase delay check.
_isSniper blocks flagged addresses from transferring or swapping.
_isExcludedFromFees bypasses fee deduction and the trading-active requirement.
_isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount bypasses transaction and wallet limits.
automatedMarketMakerPairs distinguishes buy versus sell branches in _transfer.
_swapping guard flag is read and written around swapBack inside _transfer to block nested swaps.
buyTotalFees multiplies the transfer amount when computing buy fees.
sellTotalFees multiplies the transfer amount when computing sell fees.
_tokensForLiquidity is incremented by the liquidity share of collected fees.
_tokensForMarketing is incremented by the marketing share of collected fees.
_tokensForDev is incremented by the dev share of collected fees.
_tokensForLiquidity is used to derive liquidityTokens in swapBack.
_tokensForMarketing is used to derive ethForMarketing in swapBack.
_tokensForDev is used to derive ethForDev in swapBack.
swapBack resets _tokensForLiquidity to zero after distribution.
swapBack resets _tokensForMarketing to zero after distribution.
swapBack resets _tokensForDev to zero after distribution.
_transfer calls swapBack, which performs external router calls while token accounting is in progress.
swapBack calls _swapTokensForEth to convert tokens into ETH.
swapBack calls _addLiquidity to pair leftover tokens with received ETH.
_swapTokensForEth invokes the untrusted router swap external call.
_addLiquidity invokes the payable addLiquidityETH external call on the router.
withdrawFees sends the contract ETH balance to the feeWallet address.
updateFeeWallet reads the old feeWallet for the update event and writes the new one.
withdrawFees performs an unrestricted ETH transfer to an external feeWallet address.
A contract feeWallet can re-enter withdrawFees during the ETH transfer callback.
The Uniswap swap external call can re-enter token transfer logic while fees are being accounted.
The addLiquidityETH external call can re-enter swapBack state before token fee counters are settled.
receive() lets the contract hold ETH that withdrawFees later forwards.

normalization_plan.reason: The from address parameter only feeds the _transfer core function and carries no independent identity.
The to address parameter is consumed solely by limit and fee checks inside _transfer.
The amount parameter only participates in _transfer arithmetic and limit comparisons.
The fees local is computed and spent entirely inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance exists only to decide the swapBack trigger inside _transfer.
liquidityTokens is a temporary derived value used only within swapBack.
newWallet is only assigned into feeWallet inside updateFeeWallet.
The snipers_ array is only iterated to write the _isSniper mapping.
tokenAmount is only used to approve and swap within _swapTokensForEth.
newAmount is only bounded and written into swapTokensAtAmount.
